description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to property of intestate in Thammita, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510076 and 4 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including village names, cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on property registration and title settlement processes for deceased persons' estates, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
